messages:
Ajay: heads-up — saw tenant 'bluewolf' cause an ingress spike that cascaded into 429s and queue pileup on the edge. thinking out loud: add a per-tenant resilience shim that issues short-lived ephemeral leases + transparent degrade-to-cheaper-model before global shedding. prototype config below. opinions?
Maria: can we design so a misbehaving tenant doesn't bleed penalties to others? need clear isolation and observability. also audit trail for lease issuance.
Lucas: +1 to ephemeral leases. eviction policy matters — prefer timebox + simple smoothing over complex LRU for predictability. also we should cap concurrent leased tokens per region.
Ajay: agreed. initial sketch:

```yaml
resilience_shim:
  ephemeral_lease:
    ttl_seconds: 30
    max_tokens: 250
    refill_window: 60s
    smoothing: 0.6 # exponential smoothing on burst accounting
  fallback_policy:
    - downgrade_to_model: small-quant
    - degrade_endpoints: [text-completion-noncritical, assist-logging]
  safelist_prefixes: ["/health","/admin"]
  emit_metrics: [lease_issued, lease_consumed, fallback_triggered, spillover_429s]
```

Nadia: testing thought — we should run a synthetic 'beachhead' load that reproduces long-tail bursts (many short bursts across multiple keys) and check KV cache pressure when falling back to downgraded models. I'll spin up a job.
ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary rollout of resilience-shim to edge-cluster-7 at 7632110100 :rocket:
Maria: telemetry checklist: token-level breakdown, per-prefix latency buckets, model-switch counts, and a lease-audit log (who got what and why). we need to link to billing to avoid surprise cost.
Lucas: also add a graceful window: when lease exhausted, instead of immediate 429, route N% of requests to fallback model for W seconds, then start shedding. N and W should be configurable per-tier.
Ajay: good call. also want a global guard that refuses to issue more than X ephemeral leases per tenant per minute to avoid gaming. can we detect synthetic-tenant farming?
Maria: heuristic: correlation of token adoption vs historical baseline + sudden KV-miss spike. tie into abuse signals service. but keep false-positive rate low.
Nadia: I'll run chaos testing: kill model-tier-small in the canary after fallback triggers and see end-to-end behavior (metrics, rollout rollback). will report back 7632110500.
Ajay: next steps — I'll open an RFC follow-up with interface boundaries: lease API (issue/revoke/query), telemetry schema, and fallback contract (compatible model shapes). tagging @product for SLA impact and @eng-sre for rollout playbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
